findings.excerpt: Assume AC. Fix n≥0 and V_n=F₂^{B_n}. For every r≥n+2 let D_{r,n}:π_{r+n}(T_r)→V_n pair a sphere class with the rank-r stable-coordinate classes m_{r,b}, b∈B_n.
findings.symptom: Statement and proof display formula notation literally in ordinary text (for example V_n, D_{r,n}, π_{r+n}, F₂^{B_n}, and π_{r+n}(P_r)); these are not rendered as formatted mathematics. The assumptions section does render the analogous formulas, so this is visible within the same item.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the formula-bearing notation in supported inline or display math delimiters, then rerender and confirm the notation is typeset.

findings.excerpt: Assume AC. Let R be a nonzero commutative unital ring with 2 invertible. For m≥1, H*(BSO(2m+1);R)=R[p₁,…,p_m], H*(BSO(2m);R)=R[p₁,…,p_{m−1},e] with p_m=e², and H*(BO(2m);R)=H*(BO(2m+1);R)=R[p₁,…,p_m].
findings.symptom: The statement and Gysin calculation in the proof display raw formula notation in ordinary text, including H*, p_i, p_m=e² and source-style arrows, unlike the math-rendered formulas in the Given section.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the formula-bearing notation in supported inline or display math delimiters, then rerender and confirm the notation is typeset.

findings.excerpt: Assume AC. If a based CW complex X is (c−1)-connected with c≥2, the natural actual rationalized Hurewicz map π_i(X)⊗_Z Q→H_i(X;Q) is an isomorphism for c≤i≤2c−2.
findings.symptom: The statement and final proof comparison display formula notation literally in ordinary text (π_i(X)⊗_Z Q, H_i(X;Q), and a source-typed arrow diagram), while analogous formulas in the Given section render in math styling.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the formula-bearing notation in supported inline or display math delimiters, then rerender and confirm the notation is typeset.

findings.excerpt: Assume AC. Let N≥2 and let f:(X,x₀)→(Y,y₀) be a based continuous map between nonempty path-connected simply connected CW complexes. Suppose f_*:H_i(X;Z)→H_i(Y;Z) is an isomorphism for 0≤i<N and a surjection for i=N.
findings.symptom: The statement displays the entire formula-heavy claim as plain text, including x₀/y₀, f_*, H_i and π_i with literal underscores and stars; analogous formulas in the Given section render in math styling.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the formula-bearing notation in supported inline or display math delimiters, then rerender and confirm the notation is typeset.

findings.excerpt: Assume AC. For each n≥0, the stable group π_n(MO)=colim_r π_{r+n}(T_r) maps injectively to V_n=F₂^{B_n} by the compatible detector coordinates D_{r,n}, using the cofinal tail r≥n+2.
findings.symptom: The statement displays formula notation literally in ordinary text (π_n, colim_r, π_{r+n}, T_r, F₂^{B_n}, and D_{r,n}) rather than formatted mathematics; the corresponding assumptions formulas render in math styling.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the formula-bearing notation in supported inline or display math delimiters, then rerender and confirm the notation is typeset.

findings.excerpt: Assume AC. The mod-two algebra A generated by the Steenrod squares is a connected nonnegatively graded bialgebra. Its coproduct is the algebra homomorphism Δ(Sqⁿ)=Σ_{i+j=n}Sqⁱ⊗Sqʲ, with counit ε(Sq⁰)=1 and ε(Sqⁿ)=0 for n>0.
findings.symptom: The statement and proof print formula notation literally in ordinary text, including Σ_{i+j=n}, s_n, Δ̃(s_n), and F₂, rather than typesetting it as mathematics. The Given section typesets analogous notation.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the formula-bearing notation in supported inline or display math delimiters, then rerender and confirm the notation is typeset.
